about: The words and marks the site never prints, one list read by the site's copy guard (web/src/lib/format/copy-guard.ts) and the research writer (research/capsules/site_words.py), so prose that passes the writer passes the site. Each word is a regular expression fragment matched whole and in any case, keyed to the word as a reader sees it. bettingOnly: the betting words no code says. bettingShared: the betting words that are plain words in code too. line: the betting line, with the field's own lines spared (the goal line, the offensive and defensive line, the O-line and D-line, the line of scrimmage). trading: the trading register. platform: the platform is named, never host. marks: the em dash, the en dash and the semicolon. examples: what the list catches and what it spares, held by the site's tests and the writer's, so the two builds of the pattern cannot drift.
